definitions.explanation: The act of reworking or adapting an existing creative work — a novel, play, film, or other piece — into a new version. This often involves changing the medium, updating the setting, or altering the story to suit a different audience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改作|かいさく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{改作|かいさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: They plan to adapt the original work for the stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{戯曲|ぎきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改作|かいさく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧もので、⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This film is an adaptation of a famous play and is popular with modern audiences as well.

notes:
Composed of {改|かい} (reform, change) and ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work, production). Refers specifically to reworking an existing creative work rather than creating something from scratch. Most commonly used in literary, theatrical, and film contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{改作|かいさく}: adaptation of a novel
- ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{改作|かいさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adapt for the stage
- {改作|かいさく}{版|ばん}: adapted version
- ⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改作|かいさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adapt an original work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{翻案|ほんあん}→翻案：13923_honan⟧: adaptation — emphasizes creative reinterpretation, often freer than {改作|かいさく}
- ⟦{脚色|きゃくしょく}→脚色：18162_kyakushoku⟧: dramatization — specifically adapting for stage or screen
- ⟦{改編|かいへん}→改編：17556_kaihen⟧: reorganization; adaptation — broader, can apply to organizational restructuring as well as creative works
